actions.script: const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.call.CallHandlingServices.get#DialerData').requireNewTransaction(true).disableAuthz().call() || {} const errors = ec.message.hasError() ? ec.message.errorsString : null ec.message.clearErrors() ec.web.sendJsonResponse({errors, callerIdList: out.callerIdList || [], hideCallerId: !!out.hideCallerId, recentList: out.recentList || [], phoneActive: !!out.phoneActive, homeCountryCode: out.homeCountryCode || '1'})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.call.VoiceServices.place#PhoneCall').parameters({phoneNumber: phoneNumber || '', fromNumber: fromNumber || null, hideCallerId: hideCallerId == null || hideCallerId === '' ? null : String(hideCallerId) === 'true', idempotencyKey: idempotencyKey || null}).requireNewTransaction(true).disableAuthz().call() || {} const errors = ec.message.hasError() ? ec.message.errorsString : null ec.message.clearErrors() ec.web.sendJsonResponse({reasonCode: out.reasonCode || null, errors, callSessionId: out.callSessionId || null, callLegId: out.callLegId || null, call: out.call || null, missing: out.missing || null})
